cards.text: Joshua is leading Israel now. Early the next morning, he gets up and leaves Shittim with ALL the Israelites, headed for a river they have to cross. Friend, I've watched four people take forty minutes to get out the door, so a whole camp moving out at sunrise? WOW.

cards.question: Joshua and all the Israelites leave Shittim and go as far as the ___ River, where they camp before crossing over.

cards.text: Three days later, the officers go through the camp with orders. Watch for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, carried by the Levitical priests.

cards.question: When the people see the priests carrying the ark of the covenant, what are they told to do?

answers.text: Set out from their spots and follow it
Bow down and stay in their tents
Gather around it and wait for Joshua

cards.question: The officers also tell the people to stay about two thousand cubits back from the ark. Why such a big gap?

answers.text: So they can see the way to go
So the dust stays off the ark
So the priests can walk faster

cards.text: Then Joshua has a word for the people. He tells them to consecrate themselves, and I bet every ear in that camp just perked RIGHT up.

cards.question: Joshua tells the people to consecrate themselves. What reason does he give?

answers.text: Tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among them
Tomorrow the priests will offer sacrifices
Tomorrow the kings of Canaan will attack

cards.text: Joshua tells the priests to take the ark and go on ahead of the people, and out front they go. Then the LORD tells Joshua that today He'll begin to exalt him in the sight of all Israel.

cards.question: The LORD says He'll begin to exalt Joshua in front of all Israel. What will that show the people?

answers.text: God is with him just as with Moses
Joshua is wiser than all the priests
Joshua will be crowned as their king

cards.question: The LORD tells Joshua that the priests carrying the ark should stay on the bank and keep their feet out of the Jordan.

cards.text: Joshua calls everybody in to hear the words of the LORD their God. He says the living God will surely drive out SEVEN nations, from the Canaanites to the Jebusites, and then he tells them how they'll know it.

cards.question: Joshua says to choose twelve men, and all twelve come from the tribe of Levi.
Joshua says the ark will go ahead of them into the Jordan. When the priests' feet touch the water, what will the flowing water do?

answers.text: Stop and stand up in a heap
Rise up and flood the camp
Drop down to a shallow stream

cards.text: So the people break camp, and the priests carry the ark out in front. Now hold on, friend, because you need to know something about the Jordan at harvest time.

cards.question: During the harvest season, the Jordan runs low and easy to cross.

cards.text: Overflowing its banks. Of COURSE it is, right when they need to cross, like the one morning you're running early and the whole highway turns into a parking lot.

But the second the priests' feet touch the water's edge, the flowing water stands still. It backs up as far as Adam, a city near Zarethan, and the water flowing down to the Salt Sea is completely cut off.

cards.question: With the river cut off, the people cross over. Which city do they cross opposite?
In the middle of the Jordan, the priests with the ark stand firm on ___ ground until the entire ___ has crossed.

cards.text: The priests hold their ground in the middle until every last one of them is across. That's where we pause for now, friend, because trust me, this story is NOT done.
